name: Necklace of Adaptation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: You breathe normally anywhere, and have Advantage on saves against harmful gases and vapors.
text: The wearer can breathe normally anywhere and has Advantage on saving throws to resist or shake off harmful gases and vapors, including inhaled poisons, Cloudkill and Stinking Cloud effects, and certain dragons' breath weapons.
